confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors are the most reliable: they rest on Numbeo-derived Wollongong averages (inexpensive meal, three-course meal for two) and national coffee and pint data. Beer and coffee are close to national or crowd-sourced figures, not Wollongong-specific surveys. Cocktail and wine are weaker. No Wollongong-specific cocktail or wine survey was found, so cocktail is based on Melbourne/Sydney menu and crowd-sourced figures, and wine_glass is inferred from the local beer relationship (roughly 1.5x a standard beer) and Melbourne menu ranges. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and regional context. No live booking pages or current listings were inspected, and confidence there is low. FX is the RBA observation for 18 November 2026; the server handles conversion.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a mid-sized coastal city about 80 km south of Sydney, using Wollongong restaurant averages where available and national Australian averages for coffee and beer. Cocktail and wine use Melbourne and Sydney menu benchmarks adjusted down for a smaller regional market. Accommodation is estimated relative to comparable regional NSW coastal towns with Sydney-adjacent tourism demand.
